mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) increases renal toxicity risk and may potentiate primaquine's hemolytic effects, particularly in G6PD-deficient patients through additive nephrotoxicity and oxidative stress.
action: Monitor renal function closely, assess G6PD status before primaquine use, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative antimalarials if tobramycin is essential; separate dosing when possible.
